_comments.permission_file: An administrator supplies a controller-signed permission for this local run scope. Configuration and GLM output cannot grant authority.
_comments.manual: All GLM grades stay pending proposals until the administrator explicitly approves selected ids through the shared approve CLI.
_comments.supervised: Permission-bounded automatic approval uses auto_routes and min_score; conflicts/updates require explicit approval.
_comments.automatic: Permission-bounded automatic decisions use the shared control module. The grant must explicitly authorize automatic and harness.
_comments.settings: Use policy-defaults.json for all extraction/grading knobs. Model, endpoint and timeout stay CLI options. Run storage and all funnel processes belong on the external host.
